statement: The submitted implementation builds for qemu_cortex_m3.
The trusted application reaches its start marker on QEMU.
The application completes all cases with exactly one well-formed report per case.
The drain reports the correct item count for every case.
The drain reports the correct 32-bit sum for every case.
The drain reports the correct 32-bit order checksum for every case.
No queued messages remain after any drain call.
Every normal drain, including empty queues, returns zero.
